Information for Tenderer/Consultant :
Eligibility of Tenderer : 1. The minimum number of years of general experience of the Tenderer in the construction works as well as cleaning work as
Prime Contractor or Subcontractor or Management Contractor shall be 05 (Five) years. [Years counting backward from the date of
publication of IFT in the newspaper].
2. The minimum specific experience as a Prime Contractor or Subcontractor or Management Contractor in any civil construction
works or cleaning work of at least 01 (one) contract of similar nature, complexity and methods/construction technology successfully
completed within the last 05 (Five) years, each with a value of at least Tk. 1.35 crore. Similar nature, complexity and
methods/construction technology means any types of civil Construction Work or cleaning work successfully completed in a single
contract. [Years counting backward from the date of publication of IFT in the newspaper].
3. The required average annual construction turnover shall be greater than Tk 65 Lac over the last 05 (five) years. [Years counting
backward from the date of publication of IFT in the newspaper].
4. The minimum amount of liquid assets or working capital or credit facilities of the Tenderer shall be Tk 25 Lac.
5. The minimum Tender capacity shall be Taka 1.50 Crore,
6. Tenderers Must have up-to-date valid Licenses as applicable,
7. Other required eligibility and conditions of the tenderer are given in Tender Documents.
8. The Tenderer must submit detail calculation sheet of tender capacity along with valid appropriate supporting documents.
9. The Contractor who have cleaning experience will have priority for selection.
